author: Cheryl Johnson
text: As you know, the new Pennsylvania air-permit rule goes into effect next year.  I have a great opportunity to offer a new customer a complete industrial ventilation audit of their finishing operation.  If you are not familiar with this service, I can provide you with a short call on a Friday afternoon.  I have had great success with this service.

author: Mark Greenberg
text:
Walt -

I just wanted to get a feel for your business.  I know that the hay shipping season is approaching.  If you need to move hay, I would be happy to offer you our truckload capacity (flatbed or dry van) for your shipments.  I just want to get a call with you next week for 15 minutes or so.

author: Mark Greenberg
text:
Derek -

I tried to call you on the weekend, but did not get a good connection.  I also tried to call you yesterday, but, again, no luck.  I hope you are not taking this too personally.  I know you have a lot to do.  I also hope you have a good weekend.

author: Mark Greenberg
text:
Carla -

I have not heard from you since my last email from the outside sales rep at Keystone Build Supply.  I just want to check in with you.  It is now the time of year when your paving season should be in full swing.  If you are looking to boost your bottom line, you might want to think about asphalt equipment maintenance contracts.

sure if you know the right person to call.

author: Byron" "Woertz
text:
As an outside sales rep for Keystone Build Supply, I wanted to ask you if

author: Byron" "Woertz
text:
Hi Marcus,

  Why are you calling me?  I am asking you to call me.  I know you
are busy.  I want to take a few minutes of your time next week for a 15
minute phone call.

  Why do I want to speak with you?  Because you are the shipping
lead for Red Butte Growers in Idaho Falls, Idaho.  It is your potatoes
shipping season now.  I know your potatoes usually ship Sep to Jun.  I
know you usually ship your potatoes in reefer or vented van.  I know I
can quote you capacity out of the ID area in reefer or vented van for your
potatoes shipments.  I know my phone call will allow you to ask me questions
about my services.

  I know you have no other reason to call me.  I know you don't
have anything to offer me.  I know I am asking you to call me.

  I know I will get my money's worth out of my phone call.

  Byron Woertz

author: Phillip M Love
text:
I heard on a local jobs board that you guys are looking for a second shift.  
If you are looking for a low-volume aluminum shop for contract CNC machining

can't reach me I will look you up at work tomorrow morning.

Let me know if you want to make a quick call or you can just drop me a line 
back with the right person.

author: Phillip M Love
text:
I am in the market for ready-mix delivery.  Please give me a quick call or 
just reply with the right contact.

author: Phillip M Love
text:
I am hoping you will be the right person to talk with.  Rahil Jafry referred 
me to you.  I am the risk management lead for the Central Gas desk.  
Currently our traders utilize an EOL weighted average gas price report on EOL 
to set their curves for the next gas day, i.e. their curves set today for 
tomorrow's gas flow.  I was first inquiring with EOL if they could possibly 
provide this report in downloadable format(excel) and they sent me to Rahil, 
who then sent me to you.  Is this possible?  Please feel free to contact me 
for any additional information or if this is really confusing.

Please let me know if you are not the right person to contact and I will 
start over with EOL.  Thanks for your assistance in this matter.
Phillip
